purpose: Construct a deterministic battle Scenario Package from freely selected canonical entities. A real Stage Package is an optional template, never a requirement or a complete-stage-coverage gate.

input.source_stage_id: optional 4.4.54 Stage ID used only as provenance/template input
input.mode: standard/free or an explicitly implemented mode-rule ID

enemy_waves.wave_id: optional caller-owned wave ID; a fabricated native wave ID is never produced

rules.victory_rule_id: optional victory rule reference; a bare string carries no authority or ownership information and is recorded as UNKNOWN (absent/null/empty -> UNSPECIFIED)
rules.defeat_rule_id: optional defeat rule reference; a bare string carries no authority or ownership information and is recorded as UNKNOWN (absent/null/empty -> UNSPECIFIED)

compiler_requirements: Resolve every Avatar, LightCone, RelicSet, Monster and Buff reference through canonical/SQLite data by original ID and game version.
Preserve player/enemy slot, instance, wave and Buff-binding identities; never flatten waves or merge duplicate monster variants.
Resolve a Stage template before caller overrides, then retain both template provenance and override provenance.
Reject dangling, cross-version, unavailable or semantically unsupported references unless the request explicitly selects opaque-disabled behavior.
Compile entity behavior through the generic behavior IR; Scenario assembly must not read Nanoka or external raw JSON at runtime.
Emit a self-contained Scenario Package with resolved static records, behavior IDs, rules, provenance and explicit unsupported records.
Bound player_team to 1..4 combatants; zero and more than four are rejected, and duplicate slots remain rejected.
Represent every victory/defeat rule reference with an explicit resolution state so that a supplied identifier can never be read as a known or executable rule.
Retain the Stage template wave_id on every template-sourced wave, and record template and caller provenance separately for overlaid waves.

rule_reference_representation.rationale: The static content layer holds no victory/defeat rule catalogue, so no supplied identifier is promoted to RESOLVED. A bare string also does not say whether it denotes a real game rule, an unknown identifier or a caller-owned local rule, so it is classified UNKNOWN rather than caller-owned; CALLER_DECLARED_LOCAL would require a typed local-rule declaration that this contract does not define.
rule_reference_representation.no_terminal_policy_mapping: A scenario rule reference is never mapped onto an M10 terminal policy automatically.
rule_reference_representation.rule_execution_gate: DEFERRED REQUIREMENT: once behavior gaps can close, golden/executable eligibility must additionally require every rule reference to be RESOLVED. Today the static formula consults behavior gaps and policy only, and behavior compilation is always pending, so golden_eligible is always false.

static_contract_conformance.template_overlay: The resolved Stage template establishes the base ordered wave set. A caller wave whose wave_index matches a template wave replaces that wave's enemies and keeps the template wave identity; a caller wave with a new wave_index is added; template waves the caller does not mention are retained. No wave-removal mechanism exists in this contract and none is invented.
static_contract_conformance.wave_identity_retention: Every compiled wave carries wave_index, wave_id (template wave_id, caller-supplied wave_id, or null), origin (TEMPLATE|TEMPLATE_WITH_CALLER_OVERRIDE|CALLER), override_applied and a provenance block {source_stage_id, template_wave_id, template_wave_index, caller_wave_index, caller_wave_id}. A native game wave_id is never manufactured for a caller-created wave.

scenario_schema_decision.v1: pre-P1 static shape, whose rules block echoed bare victory_rule_id / defeat_rule_id strings
scenario_schema_decision.v2: P0 static monster-resolution metadata + P1 explicit rule records + wave identity/origin/provenance contract
scenario_schema_decision.rationale: Replacing the bare rule strings with structured records is not purely additive, so the version was bumped rather than silently re-interpreted. There are no exact-shape production consumers, so this is the low-cost migration window.
scenario_schema_decision.not_touched: M10 CustomScenario / ReferenceSessionSpec schemas are unrelated and were not modified.

static_contract_conformance.immutability_decision: IMMUTABILITY_DEFERRED -- the package is copy-isolated and hash-deterministic but remains a plain object; a frozen product type is a separate hardening CR.

acceptance.minimum_fixture: Two arbitrary valid avatars with loadouts, two arbitrary monsters in two ordered waves, and one Battle/Team/Enemy Buff binding compile to a self-contained deterministic package.
acceptance.stage_independence: The same fixture compiles with source_stage_id absent.
acceptance.template_compatibility: A supported Stage Package may be imported then overlaid by caller input without losing wave ordering or provenance. Concretely: template waves are retained by default; a caller wave whose wave_index matches a template wave replaces that wave's enemy set while keeping the template wave identity; a caller wave with a new wave_index adds a wave; template wave_id and provenance are retained; caller Buff bindings may be added and template Buff bindings remain. This contract provides NO enemy or Buff removal mechanism, and none is claimed.
acceptance.implemented_static_assembly: src/hsr_battle_agent/game_data/scenario_compiler.py validates and resolves the specified static entities, waves, Stage template provenance and Buff bindings with deterministic package hashes. It enforces the 1..4 player bound, emits explicit rule-resolution records and overlays caller waves on the Stage template without dropping template wave identity or provenance.

opaque_disabled_rule: opaque-disabled is restricted to debug, inspection and partial-reconstruction diagnostics. A ScenarioPackage containing a behavior-affecting disabled operation is invalid for GOLDEN_TESTED, executable coverage success, full-freeze coverage, planner validation or training corpus use.
dsh_implementation_contract: Implement a pure ScenarioCompiler that validates this input, resolves canonical records, produces a deterministic, self-contained, copy-isolated ScenarioPackage with a stable package_sha256, and reports unresolved behavior IDs before BattleState construction. Immutable product typing is deferred hardening (IMMUTABILITY_DEFERRED); the current guarantee is determinism, self-containment, copy isolation and a stable package hash. Do not encode a hard dependency on a fully enumerated Stage database.
